stories.title: India's unemployment rate falls to 5.1% in July‑September
stories.summary: The Economic Times reported that India's overall unemployment rate declined to 5.1% in the July‑September quarter. The headline notes that the drop was linked to reduced joblessness in rural areas. No further quantitative details were provided.
stories.why: A lower unemployment rate indicates easing labour‑market pressure, especially for rural workers.

stories.title: Google unveils two new TPU chips for confidential inference and expanded memory
stories.summary: Google announced two new variants of its eighth‑generation Tensor Processing Units—TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max—aimed at confidential AI workloads and larger memory capacity. TPU 8tx, designed with AMD, builds security into the hardware to keep data and model weights protected and adds a custom inferencing network that enables on‑the‑fly model distillation. TPU 8i Max combines two TPU 8i chips in a single package, doubling memory, processing power and bandwidth for handling larger query data sets.
stories.why: The chips expand Google’s in‑house AI hardware portfolio, lowering reliance on external chip suppliers while improving security and performance for cloud AI customers.

stories.title: Anthropic retracts details of $69 billion IPO filing sent to bankers. Why analysts are raising worries over valuations
stories.summary: Anthropic initially shared its IPO filing details but later retracted the information due to inaccuracies. The company aimed to sell approximately 867 million shares priced between $70 and $80 each.
stories.why: This can affect market expectations, company valuations, sector sentiment or capital flows.

stories.title: India on track to hit $1 trillion export goal by FY27, says commerce minister
stories.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India is on track to reach its $1 trillion goods and services export target for fiscal year 2027, having recorded nearly $480 billion in exports between April and September. He cited opportunities from free‑trade agreements, especially the proposed India‑EU pact, for the automobile and mobility sectors, and urged manufacturers to expand globally, improve competitiveness and use international partnerships to boost exports, investment and employment.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
